## Activity

East City Eye Clinic completed retinal photography for 222 people during May 2026. The activity was recorded as part of the clinic’s routine eye screening service. All captures were submitted for image assessment and grading in accordance with local operating arrangements. The volume provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the reporting period.

## Image quality

There were 2 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 0.9 per cent. These images could not be assessed reliably and should be considered when reviewing the clinic’s performance for May 2026. The clinic lead has asked staff to log recurring camera issues with the service desk so that equipment-related concerns can be monitored and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Grading

Grading identified 60 referable results from the submitted captures. These outcomes require the relevant follow-up pathway under local clinical arrangements. The median lag from capture to completed grade was 2 days. This measure indicates the typical interval between image capture and grading during the month and should be reviewed alongside the activity volume, ungradable rate and referable results. Further monitoring will help identify any continuing operational or equipment issues affecting service delivery.
